vectors.name: b64url_string_form_demo
vectors.comment: CANONICAL WIRE FORM: the nonce is the 43-char base64url STRING 'AAECAwQFBgcICQoLDA0ODxAREhMUFRYXGBkaGxwdHh8' (b64url-no-pad of the 32 raw bytes 0x00..0x1f), and the bound nonce is that string's ASCII bytes (len=43, prefix 0x0000002b) — NOT the decoded 32 bytes. The engine binds session_nonce = challenge.nonce.as_bytes() (the b64url string as transmitted). Binding the decoded 32 bytes instead yields a DIFFERENT hash (7f435f10dc8848ee7ac73816e3ce9380a80375245eb828c72c7f97af589d63f0), so producer/verifier/engine must all use this string form.
